issues.title: PVOS-501 — Golden Dataset Expansion 2.0
issues.objective: Expand the PVOS Golden Dataset and regression foundation using representative scenarios without adding Product behavior.
scope: Admit sanitized real-world representative scenarios through PM review
Cover multiple roof geometry cases and partition variations within existing Product authority
Cover bounded layout-constraint scenarios already supported by the C# Mainline
Preserve accepted placement, valid no-fit, and rejected-input outcomes
Expand C# regression evidence, repeatability, comparison rules, and asset integrity
out_of_scope: New Product behavior, Product Scope, Product Blueprint, EOS, or Governance changes
Automatic roof interpretation, shading, Electrical, Construction, UI, Cloud, or PVOS 2.x
Legacy Asset promotion or direct customer/confidential data admission
acceptance_criteria: Every admitted scenario has provenance, Product authority, one bounded claim, explicit non-claims, and PM admission
Every Golden asset has an immutable commit, comparison rules, and matching SHA-256
Expanded regressions validate existing C# Product behavior without introducing behavior
required_evidence: Existing asset inspection and Golden 2.0 scenario registry
Golden asset integrity record and C# regression report

issues.title: PVOS-502 — Python Validation Tool v0.1
issues.objective: Consolidate the existing Python Validation Short Track Prototype into a controlled v0.1 Validation Tool.
scope: Validate the PM-admitted Golden manifest and registered assets
Produce stable evidence reports with PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED semantics
Perform repeatability, integrity, prerequisite, and negative-case checks
Invoke the existing C# CLI externally as the Product behavior authority
out_of_scope: Placement, geometry, capacity, warning, error, or Product result calculation in Python
A second PVOS Engine, Runtime, Product adapter, or replacement for C# Mainline
Product Scope, Blueprint, EOS, Governance, PVOS 1.1 status, or PVOS 2.x changes
deliverables: Python Validation Tool v0.1 Evidence Package
acceptance_criteria: Manifest validation and evidence reports are deterministic and traceable
Repeatability and negative checks preserve explicit PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED outcomes
Source and changed-file inspection prove Python performs no Product calculations and does not replace C# Mainline
required_evidence: Existing Prototype inspection and versioned tool identity
Unit, integration, negative, and repeatability results
C# Mainline non-replacement and scope-boundary proof

issues.title: PVOS-503 — Runtime Workflow Enhancement
issues.objective: Enhance the bounded PVOS Runtime workflow from Project Input through Validation to a traceable Result Package.
scope: Define Project Input mapping to the current Runtime Input Contract
Define the engineer Runtime workflow and validation sequence
Define a traceable Result Package for Runtime-owned results, diagnostics, and evidence
Review compatibility with the existing CLI, tests, Golden evidence, and consumers
out_of_scope: Presentation recalculation of placement or any Runtime-owned Product value
UI, persistence platform, Cloud, source-specific adapter, or Canonical Project Model implementation
Product Scope, Product Blueprint, EOS, Governance, or PVOS 2.x changes
acceptance_criteria: Project Input, Runtime, Validation, and Result Package responsibilities are explicit
The C# Mainline remains the only creator of Product results
Result presentation and packaging preserve membership, ordering, geometry, status, warnings, and errors without recalculation

issues.title: PVOS-504 — Canonical Project Model Review 2
issues.objective: Reassess Canonical Project Model Promotion eligibility using factual evidence while preserving the current no-promotion boundary.
scope: Review candidate schema and field semantics
Review ownership and separation from Runtime, adapters, presentation, and Legacy evidence
Review compatibility and versioning requirements
Review migration evidence from current typed request and result contracts
Record exactly one allowed eligibility disposition
out_of_scope: Canonical Project Model or Legacy Asset Promotion
Product Contract, Product Scope, Product Blueprint, or C# domain model modification
Implementation commitment, PVOS 2.x, EOS, or Governance changes
acceptance_criteria: Schema, ownership, compatibility, migration, Product need, acceptance, and authority each have evidence or an explicit gap
Disposition is NOT_ELIGIBLE, MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, or ELIGIBLE_FOR_SEPARATE_BASELINE_PROPOSAL
No disposition directly promotes an asset or modifies the Product Contract
required_evidence: Disposition, gaps, zero-promotion proof, and changed-file audit

issues.title: PVOS-505 — Integration Roadmap Review
issues.objective: Prepare a non-binding review of possible future PVOS integration roadmaps.
scope: Review AutoCAD Adapter responsibilities, contracts, dependencies, and validation prerequisites
Review future Electrical Roadmap information needs and ownership questions
Review future Shading Roadmap inputs, result ownership, and evidence prerequisites
Record candidate sequences, open questions, dependencies, and non-claims
out_of_scope: Implementation commitment, delivery date, implementation Issue, or Product acceptance claim
Full AutoCAD integration, Electrical implementation, Shading implementation, UI, Cloud, Construction, or AI Design
Product Scope, Product Blueprint, PVOS 1.1 status, PVOS 2.x, EOS, Governance, or Legacy Promotion changes
acceptance_criteria: Each roadmap states responsibilities, dependencies, evidence prerequisites, and explicit non-claims
The review creates no implementation commitment or Product Scope authority
Excluded implementation areas remain absent from changed files
required_evidence: Review-only roadmap with dependencies and open questions
